title: Trigun
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: On the desert planet Gunsmoke, the gunman Vash the Stampede carries a sixty-billion-double-dollar bounty for destroying the city of July, which he cannot clearly remember. Despite inhuman skill with a gun, he refuses to kill and uses his weapons to save lives, shadowed by two insurance agents and sometimes joined by the gun-toting priest Nicholas D. Wolfwood. This first three-volume series begins revealing his past and his twin brother Knives, continued in Trigun Maximum.
life_message: Every life is worth saving, even an enemy's, and love and peace are worth holding to at great personal cost.

winners_losers: Vash keeps his vow and saves lives; bounty hunters and Knives's agents lose. Sympathy goes firmly to mercy.
